comment: LARP1F.25L for RNAVProcedureTests::testLEBL_LARP2F, which flies it with the GPS.
Leg 1 is a heading-to-altitude, which has no position: the test asserts it
sits at (0,0). Leg 3 (LBA01 -> LBA02) has a true course of 199, and must be
the current leg 180s after reaching the leg 1 altitude. LARPA is leg 8, and
its distance along the route is asserted.
